title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level B -2 Q11: Pool Tournament Teams
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level B -2 第11题：泳池比赛分组

content.en: 13 then 19 children signed up. Six equal teams are needed. At least how many more children must sign up?
content.zh: 先有 13 人再有 19 人报名。需要六组人数相等。至少还要几人报名？

explanation.en: 13+19=32; next multiple of 6 is 36 ⇒ need 4 more.
explanation.zh: 13+19=32；下一个 6 的倍数是 36 ⇒ 还要 4 人。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level B -2 Q12: Largest 2×2 Sum
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level B -2 第12题：最大2×2和

content.en: In the 4×4 grid, what is the largest sum of numbers in a 2×2 square?
content.zh: 4×4 方格中，最大的 2×2 数字之和是多少？

explanation.en: The maximum 2×2 sum in the grid is 14.
explanation.zh: 网格中最大 2×2 之和为 14。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level B -2 Q13: Two-Stove Cooking
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level B -2 第13题：双炉烹饪

content.en: Cook 5 dishes (40,15,35,10,45 min) on 2 stoves; remove only when done. Shortest total time?
content.zh: 两炉做 5 道菜（40、15、35、10、45 分钟），做完才能取下。最短总时间？

explanation.en: Optimal schedule on two stoves finishes in 75 minutes.
explanation.zh: 两炉最优安排总时间 75 分钟。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level B -2 Q14: Circle Question Mark
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level B -2 第14题：圆圈里的问号

content.en: Which number should be written in the circle with the question mark?
content.zh: 问号圆圈里应填哪个数？

explanation.en: Working backwards/forwards along the operations gives 13.
explanation.zh: 沿运算正推或反推得问号为 13。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level B -2 Q15: Ink on Building Plan
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level B -2 第15题：平面图墨迹

content.en: Some ink covers numbers on the building-block plan. What is the sum of the numbers under the ink?
content.zh: 积木平面图上墨迹盖住一些数字。墨迹下数字之和是多少？

explanation.en: The covered plan numbers sum to 5.

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level B -2 Q16: How Long Is the Train
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level B -2 第16题：火车有多长

explanation.en: From the bridge/tunnel lengths in the figure, the train is 115 m.
explanation.zh: 由图中桥/隧道长度关系得火车长 115 m。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level B -2 Q17: Leave for Training
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level B -2 第17题：出发去训练

content.en: George’s training starts at 5:00 pm. Walk 5 min to bus, 15 min bus, 5 min walk to field. When must he leave home?
content.zh: 训练 5:00 pm 开始；到站 5 分钟、巴士 15 分钟、再走 5 分钟。他何时出门？

explanation.en: Total travel 5+15+5=25 min ⇒ leave at 4:35 pm (option A).
explanation.zh: 路程共 25 分钟 ⇒ 4:35 pm 出门（选项 A）。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level B -2 Q18: Zoo Two-Animal Tours
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level B -2 第18题：动物园两动物行程

content.en: Zoo has giraffe, elephant, lion, turtle. Susan sees 2 different animals and won’t start with the lion. How many tours?
content.zh: 动物园有长颈鹿、大象、狮子、龟。看 2 种动物且不以狮子开头，有多少种行程？

explanation.en: 4×3=12 ordered pairs, minus 3 that start with lion ⇒ 9 tours.
explanation.zh: 4×3=12 种有序对，去掉以狮子开头的 3 种 ⇒ 9。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level B -2 Q19: Brothers Eat Cookies
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level B -2 第19题：兄弟吃曲奇

content.en: Four brothers ate 11 cookies, all different positive amounts. Three ate 9 total; one ate exactly 3. How many did the biggest eater eat?
content.zh: 四兄弟共吃 11 块，数量互不相同且至少 1。其中三人共 9 块，有一人恰吃 3 块。最多的那人吃了几块？

explanation.en: Amounts are distinct positive integers summing to 11; one is 3; three sum to 9 ⇒ largest is 5.
explanation.zh: 互异正整数和 11，含 3，三人和 9 ⇒ 最大为 5。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level B -2 Q20: Candy Bags for Eric
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level B -2 第20题：Eric 的糖果

content.en: Bags hold 1–10 candies (all different). Five boys take two bags each. Alex 5, Bob 7, Charles 9, Dennis 15. How many did Eric get?
content.zh: 十袋糖果 1–10 粒。五人各拿两袋：Alex5、Bob7、Charles9、Dennis15。Eric 拿了几粒？

explanation.en: Used pairs leave Eric with 1+10+… → 19 candies.
explanation.zh: 其余人用去的袋子推出 Eric 为 19 粒。
